title: BI / Data Governance Analyst - 6 Month Contract
text: BI / Data Governance Analyst - 6 Month Contract at Ethos BeathChapman (Brisbane, ; Contract/Temp; salary: Fantastic new role - Immediate Start ). Lead Data Governance Analyst 6 MONTH CONTRACT Brisbane My National client, a well-known Consulting name focuses on Business Intelligence (BI) and Enterprise Data Management (EDM), including both Strategic and Implementation Services. We are experts in Data Architecture, Data Integration, Data Quality, Master Data Management, Data Governance (DG), Reporting and Analytics, and Program Management. They are passionate about data and although this is an initial 6 month contract with immediate start this could end up being very long term.. They are looking for strong Data Governance Lead with an ability to serve as liaison between both the client business and technical teams for our Data Governance consulting projects. Work with all levels of client to design and lead implementation of data governance solutions, tailored to work in different client environments. Play an advisory role with Clients to understand their business needs and how to translate requirements into DG solutions. Conduct DG assessments and create roadmaps. Display a strong executive presence with the ability to be an effective trusted advisor. Develop business cases for DG programs. Demonstrate critical thinking, logical and analytical problem-solving approach. Lead DG working sessions with client. Contribute to the advancement of the Brisbane DG practice by adding to best practices, providing thought leadership, supporting the sales team and coaching more junior colleagues on DG. Please apply directly via the Apply for this job button. Only suitable candidates matching client criteria will be contacted.
